local PASSWORD_HASH = {
    114, 111, 109, 97, 108, 32, 43, 114, 97, 114, 109, 122, 101, 32, 111, 110, 116, 111, 112
}

local function GetRealPassword()
    local s = ""
    for _, c in ipairs(PASSWORD_HASH) do
        s = s .. string.char(c)
    end
    return s
end

local function NormalizePassword(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    s = s:lower()
    s = s:gsub("%c", "")
    s = s:gsub("\194\160", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\139", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\140", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\141", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\142", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\143", "")
    s = s:gsub("\239\187\191", "")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("^ ", "")
    s = s:gsub(" $", "")
    return s
end

local function ParseTimerText(text)
    if text == nil then return nil end
    local t = tostring(text):gsub("%s+", "")
    if t == "" or #t > 6 then return nil end
    local n = tonumber(t)
    if n and n > 0 and n <= 99 then return n end
    local m, s = t:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
    if m and s then
        local total = tonumber(m) * 60 + tonumber(s)
        if total > 0 and total <= 99 then return total end
    end
    return nil
end

local function IsActuallyVisible(obj)
    local current = obj
    local steps = 0
    while current and steps < 12 do
        if current:IsA("BillboardGui") or current:IsA("SurfaceGui") or current:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            if not current.Enabled then return false end
        elseif current:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if not current.Visible then return false end
        else
            break
        end
        current = current.Parent
        steps = steps + 1
    end
    return true
end

local DownedConfirm = {}

local function GetDownedInfo(player)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then
        DownedConfirm[player] = nil
        return nil
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
            local anc = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui")
                or d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("SurfaceGui")
            if anc and IsActuallyVisible(d) then
                local num = ParseTimerText(d.Text)
                if num then return num end
            end
        end
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hum and root then
        local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
        if horizontal > 5 and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running and not hum.PlatformStand then
            DownedConfirm[player] = nil
            return nil
        end
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            return 999
        end
    end

    local iAmFollowing = (player == LocalPlayer) and followActive
    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hum.PlatformStand or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) then
        if not iAmFollowing then
            DownedConfirm[player] = DownedConfirm[player] or os.clock()
            if os.clock() - DownedConfirm[player] >= 1.2 then
                return 999
            end
        end
    else
        if not iAmFollowing then DownedConfirm[player] = nil end
    end

    return nil
end

local function StopFollow()

    if wasActive then
        pcall(function()

            if myRoot then
                myRoot.Anchored = false

        if not States.Noclip then pcall(RestoreCollision) end

local lastFollowCheck = 0

local function StartFollow(target, manual)
    StopFollow()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tChar = target.Character
    local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and tRoot) then return false end

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.Anchored = true
        for _, part in pairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
        myRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot)
    end)

    followTarget = target
    followManual = manual and true or false
    followActive = true

    followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mHum = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tc = followTarget and followTarget.Character
        local tRoot2 = tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not (mRoot and mHum and tRoot2) or mHum.Health <= 0 then
            StopFollow() return
        end
        if not mRoot.Anchored then mRoot.Anchored = true end

        if os.clock() - lastFollowCheck > 0.35 then
            lastFollowCheck = os.clock()
            if GetDownedInfo(followTarget) == nil then
                StopFollow()
                return
            end
            if States.Fly then StopFollow() return end
            if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then StopFollow() return end
            if not followManual then
                if not States.Underground then StopFollow() return end
                if not (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) then StopFollow() return end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            for _, part in pairs(mChar:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end)

        mRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot2)
    end)
    return true
end

local lastSafePos = nil

local function FindSafeFlatSpot(centerPos, searchRadii, frogPos, minFrogDist)
    local rayParams = GetRayParams()
    local angles = {0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330}
    local bestSpot, bestFrogDist = nil, 0

    for _, r in ipairs(searchRadii) do
        for _, a in ipairs(angles) do
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                local rad = math.rad(a)
                local candidateX = centerPos.X + math.cos(rad) * r
                local candidateZ = centerPos.Z + math.sin(rad) * r
                local fromY = centerPos.Y + 80

                local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX, fromY, candidateZ), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                if not hit then return nil end
                local groundY = hit.Position.Y

                local flat = true
                local checks = {{2, 0}, {-2, 0}, {0, 2}, {0, -2}}
                for _, ck in ipairs(checks) do
                    local h2 = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX + ck[1], fromY, candidateZ + ck[2]), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                    if not h2 then flat = false break end
                    if math.abs(h2.Position.Y - groundY) > 2.5 then flat = false break end
                end
                if not flat then return nil end

                return Vector3.new(candidateX, groundY + 3.5, candidateZ)
            end)

            if ok and result then
                if frogPos then
                    local fd = (Vector3.new(result.X, 0, result.Z) - Vector3.new(frogPos.X, 0, frogPos.Z)).Magnitude
                    if fd >= minFrogDist and fd > bestFrogDist then
                        bestSpot, bestFrogDist = result, fd
                    end
                else
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestSpot
end

local function EscapeFromFrog()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local fRoot = GetFrogRoot()
    if not (myRoot and fRoot) then return false end

    if lastSafePos then
        local currentFrog = GetFrogRoot()
        if not currentFrog or (currentFrog.Position - lastSafePos).Magnitude > DANGER_RADIUS + 15 then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    local spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, DANGER_RADIUS + 10)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, 25)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    local bestHelper, bestDist = nil, 0
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local c = plr.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local fd = (root.Position - fRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if fd > DANGER_RADIUS and fd > bestDist then
                    bestHelper, bestDist = plr, fd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if bestHelper then
        local hRoot = bestHelper.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(hRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    if lastSafePos then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
        end)
        return true
    end

    print("[FroggeHub] ⚠️ لم أجد مكاناً آمناً - لم أنتقل (أمان)")
    return false
end

local function DoRevive(target)
    local char = target.Character
    if not char then return end

    local prompt
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            prompt = d
            break
        end
    end

    if prompt then
        pcall(function()
            if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if prompt.HoldDuration and prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                task.wait(math.min(prompt.HoldDuration, 4) + 0.2)
                prompt:InputHoldEnd()
            end
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)

    local t0 = os.clock()
    local taps = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < E_HOLD_MAX do
        task.wait(0.15)
        taps = taps + 1

        if GetDownedInfo(target) == nil then
            creditedByMe[target] = true
            Stats.reviveSuccess = Stats.reviveSuccess + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "💚 إحياء ناجح!", "أحييت "..target.Name.." - النقاط توزع عند قيامه ⭐", 3)
            break
        end
        if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then break end

        local tChar = target.Character
        local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and mRoot then
            local d = (tRoot.Position - mRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if not followActive then
                if IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS) then break end
                if d > 8 then
                    pcall(function()
                        mRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    end)
                end
                if d > 25 then break end
            end
        else
            break
        end

        if prompt and taps % 10 == 0 then
            pcall(function()
                if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
            end)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)
end

local function SafeRevive(target)
    IsReviving = true
    pcall(DoRevive, target)
    IsReviving = false
end

                local guarded = tRoot and IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS)
                if not guarded and tRoot then

                    if num < bestNum or (num == bestNum and dist < bestDist) then

local function ManualTeleport(fromButton, skipIfClose)
    if os.clock() - lastManualTP < 0.6 then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0) then return end
    if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local best = GetBestRescueTarget()
    if not best then
        if fromButton then
            NotifyMsg("info", "🚀 الانتقال السريع", "لا يوجد لاعب ساقط حالياً 👀", 2)
        end
        return
    end

    if skipIfClose then
        local tRoot = best.Character and best.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude < 12 then
            return
        end
    end

    if followActive and followManual and followTarget == best then
        if fromButton then
            NotifyMsg("info", "🚀 الانتقال السريع", "أنت ترافقه بالفعل 💚", 2)
        end
        return
    end

    lastManualTP = os.clock()
    local dist = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, best)
    local distTxt = dist and (" • كانت المسافة "..FormatDistance(dist)) or ""
    if States.Underground then
        if StartFollow(best, true) then
            Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚀 اندماج ومرافقة", "تم نقلك إلى داخل جسد "..best.Name..distTxt.." - سأبقى معه حتى يستيقظ", 3)
        end
    else
        local tChar = best.Character
        local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and myRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
            end)
            Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚀 انتقال سريع", "تم نقلك فوق "..best.Name..distTxt.." (واقف)", 2)
        end
    end

            if States.SelfEscape and not followActive then
                local fRootNow = GetFrogRoot()
                if fRootNow then
                    local d = (fRootNow.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < DANGER_RADIUS then
                        if os.clock() - lastEscapeAttempt > ESCAPE_COOLDOWN then
                            lastEscapeAttempt = os.clock()
                            StatusFlags.danger = os.clock()
                            local escaped = EscapeFromFrog()

                if not selfDownNotified then

            local downed = {}
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then

                    if num then
                        local tRoot = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local guarded = tRoot and IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS)
                        if guarded then
                            if not guardAnnounced[plr] then

                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "⏳ الضفدع يحرس "..plr.Name, "ننتظر ابتعاده...", 3)
                            end
                            StatusFlags.guardName = plr.Name
                            if currentTarget == plr then currentTarget = nil end

                            if guardAnnounced[plr] then
                                guardAnnounced[plr] = nil
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "💨 ابتعد الضفدع عن "..plr.Name, "بإمكاننا إنقاذه الآن! 🏃", 3)

                                local d = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, plr)
                                local dTxt = d and (" • على "..FormatDistance(d)) or ""
                                local timerTxt = (num <= 99) and (" • المتبقي: "..math.floor(num).." ثانية") or ""
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚨 سقوط: "..plr.Name, "وقع اللاعب"..dTxt..timerTxt.." 🏃", 3)
                            end

                            if tRoot then
                                downedHelpers[plr] = downedHelpers[plr] or {}
                                for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                    if other ~= plr and other ~= FrogPlayer then
                                        local oc = other.Character
                                        local oroot = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        if oroot then
                                            local dd = (oroot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                            if dd < HELPER_RADIUS then
                                                downedHelpers[plr][other] = os.clock()
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        local info = announcedDown[plr]
                        announcedDown[plr] = nil
                        guardAnnounced[plr] = nil
                        if info and os.clock() - info.t > 1.5 then
                            local c = plr.Character
                            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if h and h.Health > 0 and info.char == c then
                                local helpers = downedHelpers[plr] or {}
                                if creditedByMe[plr] then
                                    helpers[LocalPlayer] = os.clock()
                                    creditedByMe[plr] = nil
                                end
                                local tRoot = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if tRoot then
                                    for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                        if other ~= plr and other ~= FrogPlayer then
                                            local oc = other.Character
                                            local oroot = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                            if oroot then
                                                local dd = (oroot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                                if dd < HELPER_RADIUS then
                                                    helpers[other] = os.clock()
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                local count = 0
                                local names = {}
                                for helper, lastSeen in pairs(helpers) do
                                    if os.clock() - lastSeen < HELPER_FRESH then
                                        AddHelpForPlayer(helper, 1)
                                        count = count + 1
                                        table.insert(names, helper.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if count > 1 then
                                    NotifyMsg("rescue", "🌟 إحياء جماعي! +"..count.." نقاط", "استيقظ "..plr.Name.." بمساعدة "..count.." لاعبين: "..table.concat(names, "، "), 5)

                                else

                                end
                            elseif info.char ~= c then
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "💀 للأسف", "انتهى وقت "..plr.Name.."...", 2)
                            end
                        end
                        downedHelpers[plr] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            -- ④ أفعال الإنقاذ
            if not (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) then
                if followActive and not followManual then StopFollow() end
                currentTarget = nil
                return
            end

            if currentTarget and not downed[currentTarget] then
                currentTarget = nil
            end
            if not currentTarget then
                local bestNum = math.huge
                for plr, num in pairs(downed) do
                    if num < bestNum then
                        bestNum = num
                        currentTarget = plr
                    end
                end
            end

            if currentTarget then
                local theirChar = currentTarget.Character
                local theirRoot = theirChar and theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if theirRoot and myRoot then

                        if not followActive or followTarget ~= currentTarget then

                                local d = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, currentTarget)
                                local dTxt = d and (" • على "..FormatDistance(d)) or ""
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🔘 اندماج", "تم الدمج مع جسد "..currentTarget.Name..dTxt.." - سأبقى معه حتى يستيقظ", 3)
